data.name: Kadil
data.gender_notes: Kadil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'K-D-L', which means 'to be just'. This name symbolizes fairness, justice, and equality in all aspects of life. In Islamic history, the term 'Kadil' has been used to refer to a just and impartial ruler or judge. This name is a reminder of the importance of justice and equity in our actions and decisions.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the balance and equilibrium in life
data.etymology: Kadil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Just, Fair, Equitable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kadil total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
